subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should HOOK.md gain a 1 MiB whole-file package limit across installation and discovery, or should readers bound only the leading frontmatter they parse?
rationale: Both choices prevent unbounded allocation, but they establish different compatibility contracts for existing hook packages and must remain consistent across this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101472.

options.title: Bound frontmatter only
options.body: Preserve large documentation bodies while rejecting an excessively large or unterminated metadata prefix through one shared race-safe reader.

options.title: Adopt a 1 MiB file limit
options.body: Treat HOOK.md as a size-bounded package artifact and document, test, and consistently enforce that limit in installation and discovery.

recommendation.title: Bound frontmatter only
recommendation.body: Preserve large documentation bodies while rejecting an excessively large or unterminated metadata prefix through one shared race-safe reader.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the hook installation contract, is the strongest history owner for the affected paths, and is currently assigned to this PR.
